inventories.inventory:
---

# NEVER CHANGE THE KEY NAME "buildserver"!
buildserver:
  hosts:
    aospbuild:
      ansible_host: 10.112.0.24    # REPLACE or enable next line:
      #ansible_connection: local   # outcomment ansible_host when enabling this
      ansible_ssh_user: droidme    # REPLACE with your actual build user

# NEVER CHANGE THE KEY NAME "downloadserver"!
downloadserver:
  hosts:
   # NEVER CHANGE THE KEY NAME "leechserver"!
   leechserver:
     ansible_host: 10.112.0.19       # REPLACE or enable next line:
     #ansible_connection: local      # outcomment ansible_host when enabling this
     ansible_ssh_user: jenkins       # REPLACE

all:
  vars:
    ############# DEBUG - START #############
    
    # TEMP!!! ASB patch date override, month+1:
    #sec_patch_date_last: 202509
    # TEMP!!! CVE Kernel patch tag override, exactly as it should be:
    #cve_tag: 202512

    # TEMP !! push missing?!
    #just_git_push: True

    # TEMP !! Kernel patch tests
    #build_bootimage_only: true
    #notify_min: True

    # TEMP !! SKIP git push
    #commit_push: False

    ############# DEBUG - END #############
    
    ############# Buildserver paths #############
    
    BUILDHOME: "/home/droidme" # the home path of the buildserver user (see above: buildserver>hosts>aospbuild>ansible_ssh_user)
    keys_base_path: "{{ BUILDHOME }}/KEYS"   # all signing keys go here
    android_build_path: "/usr/src/android"   # root path of where you wanna place android sources
    DOSPATH: "{{ android_build_path }}/axp"  # divest path (keep it like that if unsure)
    SRCPATH: "{{ DOSPATH }}/Build/LineageOS-{{ los_version }}"
    #CCACHE_DIR: "{{ android_build_path }}/ccache/{{ android_shortversion }}"   # full path where to place ccache data
    CCACHE_DIR: "/ccache/{{ android_shortversion }}"   # full path where to place ccache data
    CCACHE_COMPRESS: 0  # 0 = do not compress, 1 = compress
    repo_bin: "{{ BUILDHOME }}/.local/bin/repo" # full path to your repo binary
    zipdir_mntp: "{{ android_build_path }}/zips/{{ target_model }}" # target directory for the final OS zips
    server_tmp_dir: "{{ android_build_path }}/.tmp"
    git_axpos_org_private_host_port: 8443  # custom https port for reaching git_axpos_org_private_host
    
    #max_processes: 22  # how many threads to use for CPU tasks (e.g. build, git unpack etc), default is set here: https://github.com/sfX-android/automation_scripts/blob/ansible/roles/common/defaults/main.yml
       
    ############# Optional variable overrides #############
    
    release_gpg_signing_key: "FE4B2FA2B225F0AB903AF4136740E645718A8E47"
    git_commit_args: "-S"
    
    # maximal ccache size - per Android(!) version (default 10G)
    # if building for A11 and A15 the disk usage is ccache_max_size * 2
    # or ccache_max_size * 3  when building for 3 versions etc!!
    # recommended when building for multiple kernel sources: 100G
    # recommended when building for 1 device only: 25-50G
    ccache_max_size: 100G
    
    # Telegram notifications are enabled by default
    #telegram_notifications: False

    # this should always be set to False as long as your are not using
    # using your own automation repo
    #use_secrets_yaml: False
    
    # when the Semaphore/Ansible server uses a different python version than the buildserver
    # you might get an error about the python interpreter. the following should match the
    # python version on the Semaphore/Ansible server AND buildserver
    ansible_python_interpreter: /usr/bin/python3
    
    # default is false but here, we WANT notifications:
    telegram_notifications: true

    # we WANT to release (default is True)
    skip_release_publish: False
    
    # home path of the semaphore(!) user running the semaphore service
    semaphore_home_dir: /opt/scriptserver
    ansible_home_dir: "{{ semaphore_home_dir }}"  # don't touch unless you really know what you are doing!

    # when a new build starts previous log files will be automatically deleted when "False"
    #keep_build_logs: False
    
    # if the recovery should be released as a separate image set this to "True"
    axp_release_recovery: True
    
    # the download server path permission will be handled with this:
    release_path_owner: steadfasterx
    release_path_group: jenkins
    release_path_perms: 0775
    
    #SEPARATE_OUT_DIR: "{{ android_build_path }}/out/{{ target_model }}/{{ ROM_FLAVOR }}-{{ android_shortversion }}"

    # base path for the kernel patcher scheduler,
    # only required if the official kernel_patches repo should NOT be used
    cve_kernel_base_path: "{{ android_build_path }}/CVE"
                                 
    # splunkpors env
    target_env: "{{ axp_type | d('Pro') }}"
